pete_taunts: Pull up a stool, toad. Pete don't lose at the counter.
Here, have some of mine. No, I insist. Heh.
Lake trout ain't trout, and you ain't hungry enough.
My apron's seen more beef than your whole block.
Chew faster, grandpa. The market closes at six!
Cookie tower's coming. Hope you saved room, hon.
swat_back: Harold: Keep your scraps on your own plate, Pete!
Harold: Nice try. That coddie's going back to you.
Harold: I've been swatting flies since Truman, pal.
mavis_fan: Mavis: Breathe, Harold! Little bites, hon!
Mavis: Sip that lemonade and show him who's boss!
Mavis: You out-ate my brother at Easter. Go!
win: Pete's apron strings snap. Harold takes the crown!
Last cookie down. The whole market cheers.
Pete pushes back his stool. 'Okay. You're hungry.'
lose: Harold taps out. Pete licks the plate clean.
Too full to croak. Pete wins this round.
The fullness meter pops. Loosen the belt, retry.

carl_taunts: Small ball, small pins, small chance for you, grandpa.
This towel's lucky. Your cane ain't.
Three balls a frame and you still can't clear it?
Welcome to my basement. Mind the low pipes, toad.
Kingpin Carl don't miss. Carl plays dead, not bad.
Ten frames, old timer. I only need nine.
bandit_heckles: Somebody spray that toad's shoes, they stink.
Hey frog, the pins are THAT way.
Bet you a sandwich he chokes on frame ten.
mavis_bonus: Mavis: Bonus ball! I bowled league in '62, hon!
Mavis: Watch the wrist, Harold. Like this!
Mavis: Strike for Mavis! Carl, fetch your towel.
win: Carl drops his lucky towel. The Bandits go quiet.
Frame ten, clean sweep. Basement belongs to Harold.
Carl plays dead. This time he means it.
lose: Carl waves his towel. The Bandits howl.
Short by a pin. Carl keeps his crown.
Gutter on ten. Rack 'em and try again.

goal: Harold: Top shelf! The cane still works!
Mavis: Purse to net! Ha! Get it, hon!
Harold: That's a goal where I come from, Rodney.
Mavis: Count it! I saw it go in!
splash_check: Splash! Into the harbor. Sit out thirty, pal.
Mavis: Oops. Swim it off, sweetie.
Harold: Hope you packed a towel, Otter.
Rodney: Hey! That water's cold, toad!
rodney_taunts: Riptide Rodney, captain of Key Highway. Bow down.
A cane ain't a stick, grandpa. Go home.
Purse checks? Lady, this is a real sport.
First to five and I'm already thinking of six.
Otters were born to swim. You're gonna learn.
Rash Field is my field. Pay the toll.
win: Five goals! Rodney slaps the turf in disbelief.
The Otters slink off to dry out. Field is ours.
Mavis spins her purse. Harold tips his cap.
lose: Rodney scores five. The Otters do a victory flip.
Checked into the harbor once too often. Retry.
Rodney keeps the field. Rematch at sundown.

crow_calls: Caw! Something croaks in the graveyard!
The Raven King sees all. Caw!
Who walks among the old stones tonight?
Roses? For the poet? Not on our watch.
Circle the wall. Check the catacombs!
harold_whispers: Harold: Easy. Crows hate a squeaky cane.
Harold: Three roses, one bottle. Then we scram.
Harold: Once upon a midnight... quiet, Harold.
Harold: Mavis would never believe this one.
clean_finish: Three roses rest at the grave. Not one caw.
Bottle left, crows none the wiser. A ghost toad.
The poet's honored. The Raven King slept through it.
caught: The flock dives! Back to the gate, Harold!
Caught under the lamplight. Try again.
The Raven King cackles. Roses dropped.

chompy: Chompy: Nom! Junk goes in, clean harbor comes out!
Chompy: Is that a boot? My favorite flavor!
Chompy: Googly eyes on the prize, Harold!
Chompy: Keep 'em coming, I've got room!
Chompy: Burp. Pardon me. Water wheel manners.
Chompy: You fish, I chomp. Best team on the pier!
rare_catch: Rare catch! A golden crab with a tiny crown!
Whoa! A rockfish as long as Harold's cane!
Legendary! The old harbor eel nobody believes in!

announcer: Engines roaring on Pratt Street! The Harbor Grand Prix is ON!
Harold launches clean off the line! Look at that frog go!
Down the straight past the ballpark, flat out!
Hairpin by the Convention Center! Brakes, brakes, brakes!
Side by side into the turn, and the toad holds!
Sparks off the wall! He kissed it and kept going!
Final lap! The whole harbor's on its feet!
Checkered flag! A grandpa toad takes the Grand Prix!

neighbors: Neighbor: Bang those pots! Harold did it!
Neighbor: Whole block's out on the stoops tonight, hon!
Neighbor: I knew that toad had it in him!
Neighbor: Look! The monument's lit up like Christmas!
Neighbor: Somebody fire up the crab pot!
Neighbor: Mavis, you married a hero!
drone_intro: Mavis: Put these goggles on, Harold. Trust me.
Harold: Whoa. I'm flying over the whole harbor!

truck_escape: Mavis: Get in, Harold! I'm driving!
Harold: Mavis, that's a beer truck!
Mavis: It's got wheels. Hold onto your hat!
chase_taunts: Brewmaster: You can't outrun a full keg, toad!
Brewmaster: Pratt Street's mine, every block of it!
Brewmaster: One eye's all I need to see you crash!
Brewmaster: Mavis drives like my grandmother!
street_rage: Brewmaster: My sign! You broke my beautiful sign!
Brewmaster: I'll hit you with every letter of it!
Brewmaster: Enough! This ends on the street!

barks: Bosun Bones: Arr, the tide brings fresh souls tonight.
Deckhand Dread: Swab the pier! Swab it forever!
Powder Monkey: Hee hee! Who wants a boom?
Bosun Bones: Off the Broadway pier, ye living toad!
Deckhand Dread: Me bones rattle for treasure.
Powder Monkey: Powder's dry, fuse is lit!
Bosun Bones: Two hundred years and still no shore leave.
Deckhand Dread: Fog's rolling in. Our kind of night.
Powder Monkey: Bosun says scare him. Booo!
Bosun Bones: Fells Point belongs to the dead after dark.
lantern_flash: Bosun Bones: Argh! Douse that light!
Deckhand Dread: Me eyes! Me hollow eyes!
Powder Monkey: Too bright! Too bright!
Bosun Bones: Back to the fog, lads!

barks: Market's closed, grandpa. Night shift is ours.
Pete said nobody touches the stalls. Nobody.
Smells like pit beef and trouble.
Hey toad, you here for leftovers?
Lights off, hands out. Pay up.
Night market rules, pal. We make 'em.

lexington_market.name: LEXINGTON MARKET
blurb: Founded in 1782, it's one of the oldest public markets in America.
Pit Beef Pete claims he's eaten at every stall since opening day.

rash_field.name: RASH FIELD
blurb: A waterfront park on the Inner Harbor's south shore by the Science Center.
Riptide Rodney calls it home turf and charges toads a toll.
